content.text:
nid = counter
            counter += 1
            rng[nid] = (lo, hi)
            if lo < hi:
                mid = (lo + hi) >> 1
                child = build(lo, mid)
                left[nid] = child
                child = build(mid + 1, hi)
                right[nid] = child
            return nid

        self.tree_root = build(0, S - 1) if S else None
        self.tree_nodes = list(range(base, counter))
        self.node_rng = rng
        self.node_left = left
        self.node_right = right
        self.leaf = {}
        for nid in self.tree_nodes:
            lo, hi = rng[nid]
            if lo == hi:
                self.leaf[lo] = nid

    def decompose(self, nid, lo, hi, out):
        node_lo, node_hi = self.node_rng[nid]
        if hi < node_lo or node_hi < lo:
            return
        if lo <= node_lo and node_hi <= hi:
            out.append(nid)
            return
        self.decompose(self.node_left[nid], lo, hi, out)
        self.decompose(self.node_right[nid], lo, hi, out)

    def _build_eligibility(self):
        times = self.times
        thresholds = self.thresholds
        self.elig = []
        self.pairs = [[] for _ in range(self.S)]
        for j, window in enumerate(self.windows):
            if not window[5] < thresholds[j]:
                self.elig.append(None)
                continue
            lo = bisect_left(times, window[1])
            hi = bisect_right(times, window[2]) - 1
            if lo > hi:
                self.elig.append(None)
                continue
            self.elig.append((lo, hi))
        for j in range(self.J):
            span = self.elig[j]
            if span is None:
                continue
            for s in range(span[0], span[1] + 1):
                self.pairs[s].append(j)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- networks
    def build_net(self, lower):
        """Certificate network with flow lower bounds `lower` per flow."""
        S, J, F, G = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G
        net = Net(self.K + len(self.tree_nodes) + 2)
        source = self.K + len(self.tree_nodes)
        sink = source + 1
        R, Z = self.R, self.Z
        arc_r_a = []
        arc_a_b = []
        arc_b_a = []
        arc_b_e = []
        for s in range(S):
            arc_r_a.append(net.add(R, self.a[s], self.I if s == 0 else self.refills[s]))
            arc_a_b.append(net.add(self.a[s], self.b[s], self.B))
            if s + 1 < S:
                arc_b_a.append(net.add(self.b[s], self.a[s + 1], self.B))
            else:
                arc_b_a.append(-1)
            arc_b_e.append(net.add(self.b[s], self.e[s], self.caps[s]))
        arc_e_leaf = []
        for s in range(S):
            arc_e_leaf.append(net.add(self.e[s], self.leaf[s], INF_CAP, self.times[s]))
        for nid in self.tree_nodes:
            child = self.node_left.get(nid)
            if child is not None:
                net.add(child, nid, INF_CAP, 0)
                net.add(self.node_right[nid], nid, INF_CAP, 0)
        attach = defaultdict(list)
        for j in range(J):
            span = self.elig[j]
            if span is None:
                continue
            nodes = []
            self.decompose(self.tree_root, span[0], span[1], nodes)
            cost = -self.readys[j] - self.values[j] * self.W
            for node in nodes:
                attach[node].append((j, net.add(node, self.w[j], INF_CAP, cost)))
        arc_w_z = [net.add(self.w[j], self.z[self.flow_of[j]], 1) for j in range(J)]
        arc_z_out = []
        for f in range(F):
            head = Z if self.fgroup[f] == -1 else self.h[self.fgroup[f]]
            arc_z_out.append(net.add(self.z[f], head, self.fceil[f] - lower[f]))
        arc_h_out = []
        for g in range(G):
            head = Z if self.gparent[g] == -1 else self.h[self.gparent[g]]
            arc_h_out.append(net.add(self.h[g], head, self.gceil[g]))
        arc_z_r = net.add(Z, R, J)
        return dict(net=net, source=source, sink=sink, attach=attach,
                    arc_r_a=arc_r_a, arc_a_b=arc_a_b, arc_b_a=arc_b_a,
                    arc_b_e=arc_b_e, arc_e_leaf=arc_e_leaf, arc_w_z=arc_w_z,
                    arc_z_out=arc_z_out, arc_h_out=arc_h_out, arc_z_r=arc_z_r)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ feasibility
    def coverage_bound(self):
        """Largest coverage ratio any allocation could reach (exact)."""
        counts = [0] * self.F
        for j in range(self.J):
            if self.elig[j] is not None:
                counts[self.flow_of[j]] += 1
        best = Fraction(1)
        for f in range(self.F):
            reachable = min(self.fceil[f], counts[f])
            ratio = Fraction(reachable, self.targets[f])
            if ratio < best:
                best = ratio
        return best

    def feasible(self, lower):
        """Hoffman-style feasibility test at the given flow lower bounds."""
        net = self.build_net(lower)
        graph = net['net']
        source, sink = net['source'], net['sink']
        balance = defaultdict(int)
        for f in range(self.F):
            balance[self.z[f]] -= lower[f]
            head = self.Z if self.fgroup[f] == -1 else self.h[self.fgroup[f]]
            balance[head] += lower[f]
        required = 0
        for node, value in balance.items():
            if value > 0:
                graph.add(source, node, value)
                required += value
            elif value < 0:
                graph.add(node, sink, -value)
        if required == 0:
            return True, None
        flow = dinic(graph, source, sink)
        if flow == required:
            return True, None
        nodes = reachable(graph, source)
        cut = sorted({node for node in nodes if node < self.K})
        return False, cut

    def solve(self, lower):
        """Optimal certified allocation at the given coverage lower bounds."""
        net = self.build_net(lower)
